_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). 04 Topography AV Test's Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids TA–TF (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

TA.name: Signal chain: slate with the chain as modules on a pulsing wire, audio network split, colour circuit over five swatch stills, full-bleed cut, versions ruler

TB.name: Survey sheet: map-cover slate with legend, grid-referenced tile mosaic, keyed process table, cut in crop marks, versions as contour rings

TC.name: Arrangement: transport-bar slate, DAW lanes with a scroll playhead, x-ray lens over the output, volume-to-hue demo, takes row, cut beside the grey terrain

TD.name: Survey sheet, keyed: TB with the networks as captioned map squares, six picture tiles, a bright cut in crop marks, contour rings that draw in and show each version

TE.name: Arrangement, tuned: TC with a red-to-orange hue fader beside the colour network, three lanes, phone clips 2-up, a transform-only lens

TF.name: Waveform: the piece as 16 frame bars sized by its loudness, the network as an exploded stack, the cut in a letterbox with running timecode, date numerals beside the grey terrain
